content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy rents you a storefront on their platform. You get payment processing, product hosting, and email delivery—all tied to their infrastructure. They own the backend. You pay 5% + $0.50 per transaction. Stripe or PayPal required. Your account lives or dies by their terms. Sovereign stacks like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploy infrastructure you own. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase stores orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. No platform. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. You own the code, the data, the stack. Lemon Squeezy is a rented apartment. Sovereign stacks are a house with a deed.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy blocks creators in Nigeria, Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and other regions. Their payment processors (Stripe, PayPal) enforce these restrictions. If your country is on the blacklist, you’re locked out. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. They use NOWPayments for crypto transactions—300+ currencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC, no buyer account required. Recommended networks (BSC, Solana, TRON) keep fees under $0.10. The stack runs on globally accessible infrastructure: GitHub, Cloudflare, Google. No single entity can block you. Lemon Squeezy’s architecture is built for Stripe’s approved countries. Sovereign stacks are built for everyone else.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Lemon Squeezy payments settle in 2–7 days, minus 5% + $0.50 per transaction. Add Stripe’s 2.9% + $0.30. Total: 7.9% + $0.80. Sovereign stacks use NOWPayments. Crypto payments confirm on-chain in minutes. Fee: 0.5%. Recommended networks (BSC, Solana, TRON) add $0.05–$0.10. Total: 0.5% + $0.10. You keep 99.5% of revenue. No payout delays. No currency conversion losses. Lemon Squeezy’s fees are higher. Their settlement times are slower. Sovereign stacks are cheaper and faster—if your buyers use crypto.
Sovereign stacks give you infrastructure ownership—not platform rental.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Lemon Squeezy owns your data. They control your storefront. They can suspend your account. File delivery relies on their servers. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Your storefront runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Order data lives in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files deliver from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments automates payment verification via webhook. The moment payment confirms, the file delivers. No manual intervention. No platform dependence. Lemon Squeezy rents you convenience. Sovereign stacks give you control.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choose Lemon Squeezy if your country is approved, you accept their fees, and you trust their platform. Choose a sovereign stack if you’re in a restricted country, need crypto payments, and want full ownership. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours. Includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments integration, 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, end-to-end tested. Lifetime access. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. Lemon Squeezy is simpler—if it’s available. Sovereign stacks are permanent—if you’re locked out. The choice is infrastructure rental vs. infrastructure ownership.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Lemon Squeezy in Nigeria?

No. Lemon Squeezy blocks creators in Nigeria because their payment processors (Stripe, PayPal) restrict the country. Sovereign commerce stacks bypass this by using globally accessible infrastructure and crypto payments.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, Solana, and TRON. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON—under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to know how to code to use a sovereign stack?
No. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is deployed and configured for you. You own the infrastructure but don’t need to manage the code unless you choose to customize it.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, your stack still runs—orders are stored in Supabase, and files remain in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You can switch payment processors without losing data.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 5 products loaded. You can add more by following the documentation provided or hiring a developer to modify the backend logic.
